title: Japan 2-Year JGB auction (No.490 inferred) — the only print on this calendar that clears on day one of a live BoJ Outlook-Report MPM
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 24,853 bytes) — its table row reads 'Oct. 29, 2026 | 2-year'. All three of the announcement, result and Non-Price-Competitive-II cells are the plain string 'Detail' with no href, so nothing about this auction has been published yet. The announcement lead is D-7 in 41 of MOF's own last 44 2-Year announcements (D-8 twice, D-10 once), so terms publish about 2026-10-22. The '(No.490)' is an INFERENCE, not MOF's print — the calendar prints an issue number only once announced. The inference is now reproduced across MOF's full published English calendar set 2301e-2611e (47 x HTTP 200, fetched direct 2026-09-09; 2201e-2212e and 2612e return 404, so this is the whole window MOF currently serves): 44 held 2-Year auctions carry issue numbers No.445 (2023-01-31) through No.488 (2026-08-28) with ZERO gaps over 3.7 years, one issue per calendar month, and the Sep. 30 / Oct. 29 / Nov. 30 rows follow unnumbered. Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office; the date is MOF's own and is not in doubt. Proposed 2026-09-09 by the never-assessed initial research of jgb-2y-auction-2026-09-30; canonical file written 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research, which shadows that proposal
notes: TITLE CORRECTED FROM THE PROPOSAL, which framed this as 'the second of the two issues that close the 1-5y menu's 2-Year coupon channel'. That is true and it is the least interesting thing about the print. The distinguishing fact, from BoJ's own published schedule (boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/index.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-09, HTTP 200): the October 2026 Monetary Policy Meeting runs Oct. 29 (Thurs.), 30 (Fri.) and carries an Outlook Report. MOF sells the 2-Year on DAY ONE of that meeting — the auction clears in Tokyo hours with the BoJ decision unresolved, and after the 2026-10-28 FOMC statement, which lands about 03:00 JST the same morning. Measured against MOF's own 44 published 2-Year results, this has happened three times: 2023-07-27 (No.451), 2023-10-30 (No.454) and 2026-07-30 (No.487). All three are Outlook-Report MPMs, and that is STRUCTURAL, not coincidence: MOF puts the 2-Year on the last business days of a month and BoJ only ever schedules a meeting that close to month-end at an Outlook MPM — every non-Outlook meeting (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec) in 2023-2027 sits mid-month. The three precedents hold the three LOWEST covers among the seven July/October auctions in the set (3.045 / 3.626 / 3.950, mean 3.540, against a 4.470 near-miss mean; exact permutation p = 0.029, the minimum attainable at C(7,3)). That does NOT survive the six comparisons run to find it, and n = 3 with two of three precedents coinciding with documented 2023 YCC changes cannot separate 'MPM day one' from 'the eve of a policy change'. Filed MIXED and registered as an out-of-sample test rather than asserted. THE OPERATIONAL WARNING FOR THE NEXT SESSION: do not score this auction's cover against the sibling's Y2.8tn-era mean of 3.885 — score it against the day-one peer set (mean 3.540). A perfectly ordinary day-one auction will read as a weak auction otherwise. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. The corridor is the densest this family has seen — 34 tracked ids within +/-5 days, including fomc-2026-10-28 at D-1, ecb-decision-2026-10-29, gdp-q3-2026-advance-2026-10-29 and pce-2026-10-29 on the day, boj-decision-2026-10-30 at D+1 and midterm-elections-2026-11-03 at D+5. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
